entity.summary: Thai centralized digital-asset exchange and brokerage platform providing cryptocurrency trading services under the WAANX brand.
entity.notes: Current first-party WAANX pages present an operating cryptocurrency trading platform and identify Waan Exchange Co., Ltd. as providing Digital Asset Exchange and Digital Asset Broker services. Thailand SEC's current licensed-operator page lists WAANX / Waan Exchange Company Limited under Digital Asset Exchange. The company page states that Waan Exchange was founded on 2022-01-28, but HEI does not infer that corporate foundation date as the exact exchange launch date.

evidence.title: WaanX Company
evidence.notes: Current first-party company page identifies Waan Exchange Co., Ltd., describes its digital asset exchange and broker operations, and presents WAANX as an active cryptocurrency trading platform.

evidence.title: List of licensed digital asset business operators — Digital Asset Exchange
evidence.notes: Current Thailand SEC license-check page lists WAANX / Waan Exchange Company Limited as a Digital Asset Exchange and links waanx.com.
